scope: Offline validation only; no robot connected or moved.
selection_reason: Final main and EMA predictions are close and both outperform the minimum-noise-loss checkpoint on the sampled action metric. EMA matches the configured inference workflow; this is not proof of closed-loop superiority.
limitations: Validation episodes were used for checkpoint selection; independent task success has not been measured.
Overall gripper MAE is higher than holding measured position, despite improvement on gripper-transition windows.
Single-observation 100-step inference median exceeds the nominal 0.8-second eight-action execution interval; robot/camera I/O is not included.
Late validation noise loss rises while sampled action error improves; loss alone is not a sufficient deployment selection rule.

latency.scope: CPU-to-GPU observation transfer + predict_action + GPU-to-CPU action transfer; excludes camera/robot I/O
